failure_reasons: On the source-exclusive validation checkpoint, delta_joint_velocity RMSE was 9.10% worse than the Persistence baseline.
On the unseen-policy held-out checkpoint, contact F1 was 0.471 left / 0.441 right and contact-mode macro-F1 was 0.306 left / 0.243 right.
Held-out slip-speed RMSE was 0.491 m/s left / 0.570 m/s right and normal-force RMSE was 358.6 N left / 362.2 N right.
Held-out root angular-velocity delta RMSE was 1.549 rad/s, above the frozen 1.0 rad/s gate.
